gap: No result ChatGPT got states that an add-on rear screen can only switch on rear seat heaters and rear climate hardware the car already has. Hansshow's own H86 listing says its seat-heat module 'requires original car to have heating'. The 2025+ Model Y Standard, the one new Model Y without a factory rear screen, has heated seats only in front, no separate rear climate zone and rear vents you adjust by hand. On that trim, an add-on screen gives rear passengers video and apps but no climate or seat control.
standout_why: I compared against the ManualsLib copy of Tesla's 2025+ Model Y owner's manual (the 'Rear Touchscreen' section, result 16) and ChatGPT's answer, which drew on tesla.com/modely, tesla.com/learn/introducing-new-model-y and the Touchscreen manual page. tesla.com returned HTTP 403 for every Tesla page I tried, so I could not open those cited pages myself. The manual lists what the factory screen does (climate, rear seat heaters, video, games, two Bluetooth headphones) but not which trims have the hardware behind those controls. ChatGPT only says 'some Standard versions do not' have the screen. The notateslaapp result (#18) is about the 16-inch center screen and never mentions a rear screen. None of the results says what an aftermarket screen can or cannot control on a car without rear heaters and powered rear vents.
decides: For a 2025+ Model Y Premium or Performance, the factory 8-inch rear screen already handles video, games, rear climate and two headphone pairs, so an add-on screen is not needed. Streaming works over Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot without paying for Premium Connectivity, according to TSLNA's Oct 2026 guide. For a 2025+ Model Y Standard, an add-on screen like the Hansshow H86 for Juniper Standard ($399.99 on our page) works only as an Android entertainment screen. Its rear climate and seat-heat controls have no hardware to drive, so the 'rear climate and seat controls' cell in our page's H86 Standard row needs fixing. Against $399.99, the $19.99 TESERY seat-back tablet mount or the Aurzen projector screen (parked only) become the value picks for that trim. For 2020–2024 cars, which have rear heaters, the Teslahubs, TESERY and Tlyard add-on screens can still control rear seat heat.
